column3: “Navel cord” follows a rare word; “certainly” (rubbing with salt) is kept.
NASB keeps the repeated “I said to you … ‘Live!’,” which some manuscripts lack. “Kicking about” is rendered “squirming.”
“Ten thousand” is rendered “numerous,” and “adornment ornaments” as “age for fine ornaments.”
“Leather” is rendered “porpoise skin”; the word is uncertain.
“On your name” is rendered “because of your fame”; the last words (“his it was”) are rendered “who might be willing.”
The end of the verse is difficult; NASB has “which should never come about nor happen.”
“Clothes of multicolored cloth” is rendered “embroidered cloth.”
“Odor of soothing” is rendered “soothing aroma,” and NASB supplies “so it happened.”
“To them” is rendered “to idols,” and NASB supplies “the fire.”
The Hebrew word for “heart” here is rare; NASB has “How languishing is your heart.” The meaning is uncertain.
